Shape the Future of Medical Technology with AKAS Medical Equipment

AKAS Medical Equipment is one of India's leading medical device manufacturers, delivering innovative healthcare solutions including Infusion Pumps, Syringe Pumps, Patient Monitors, Blood & Fluid Warmers, DVT Pumps, and other advanced medical technologies.


We are looking for a passionate Mechanical Design Engineer who enjoys transforming ideas into innovative products and wants to build a rewarding career in medical device product development.


Your Role

As a Design Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, validating, and improving mechanical components and plastic parts for next-generation medical devices. You will work closely with cross-functional teams throughout the complete product development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design mechanical components, plastic parts, sub-assemblies, and complete product assemblies using Creo Parametric.
  • Create accurate 3D models, manufacturing drawings, assembly drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOM).
  • Develop engineering concepts based on product specifications and functional requirements.
  • Improve existing designs through prototype testing, validation, and manufacturing feedback.
  • Apply GD&T, DFM, DFA, tolerance analysis, and engineering best practices.
  • Support prototype development, product validation, and functional testing.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Purchase, and R&D teams.
  • Prepare and maintain engineering documentation and design records.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Employee Benefits

  • Project Completion Incentives
  • Longevity Bonus

  • Paid Sick Leave & Paid Time Off
  • Mobile/Cell Phone Reimbursement
  • Technical & Soft Skills Training
  • Team Outings & Employee Engagement Activities
  • Excellent Career Growth in the Medical Equipment Manufacturing Industry

Why Join AKAS Medical Equipment?

  • Work on innovative medical devices that improve patient care.
  • Gain exposure to the complete product design and development lifecycle.
  • Learn from experienced R&D professionals.
  • Hands-on experience in new product development.

Job Description:

  • Guide and assist the Patients in their visits to hospital.
  • Resolve the Patients queries by being single point of contact.
  • Guidance and counseling to the patients and their families.
  • Help the Patients & relatives in taking admission and billing process.

  • Inform management of recurring problem.
  • Manages problem resolution for patient & relatives through feedback analysis in coordination with department head to develop proactive problem solutions.
  • Need to take care of all other works which is assigned by the Manager.

3. Patient Relations Officer:

Job Description:

  • Ability to work in a team environment, should be good with handling people and making avail care and treatment at the hospital or doctor.
  • Should have a basic understanding of systems and processes that are to be followed in a healthcare facility.
  • Counseling and respond to patients needs, requirements and concerns as appropriate.
  • Making patients aware of health services and facilities available for patients at Dr. KMH.
  • Investigate and/ or channel complaints or problems to appropriate head department in hospital.
  • Assist in resolving conflicts and act as an intermediary between patients, families and staff.
  • Supports/facilitates the implementation of innovation and systems that eliminate patient harm.
  • Collect data and information about patient feedback and make recommendations as appropriate.
  • Explaining policies, procedures or services to unknown patients using medical or administrative knowledge.
  • Analyzing and assessment of patients needs through IP visit.
  • Taking daily rounds in OPD, ER & other departments to ensure excellent care and services to all the patients, to co-ordinate with doctor in patient care whenever required, complaints redressal and feedback.
  • All verbal and written complaints will be investigated and responded through calls and visits in a timely manner and a summery will be reviewed once in fortnight with the core committee of the organization.
  • All suggestions will be documented by PR Team and informed to the concerned department head for assessment and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitoring and analyzing the patients rights and responsibilities.
  • Collaborates with the Quality improvement efforts to identify key improvement focus areas that impact both patient care quality and safety.
  • Need to take care of all other works which is assigned by the Manager.

4. Billing Executive

Job Description:

  • Carry out the daily activities of the department.
  • Handle Cash & Credit IP billing.
  • Interact with customers to solve various queries regarding bills.
  • File and maintain all records.
  • All the consultation, and any type of OP/IP billing have to be managed by the billing staff.
  • The complete tariff structure, Consultation charges of the doctors have to be updated in the system to avoid miscalculations.
  • Manual billing is not acceptable and computer billing needs to be followed strictly.
  • Before taking a printout of the bill, the details mentioned in the bill needs to be explained clearly to the attender along with the break up. On acceptance, a printout could be taken accordingly.

  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities.
  • Accomplishes medical office mission by completing related results as needed.
  • Reporting to Head of the Department.

  • To mark cross reference for all in patients
  • Reporting to the Head of the Department.

title: Mobile Testing Engineer - PAN INDIA @ Infosys
tagsAndSkills: Mobile Testing,Mobile Automation Testing,Mobile Automation,Automation,Pan,Automation testing,Software testing
jobDescription:
EXP RANGE : 4 TO 10 YEARS


Location : Hyderabad

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Mobile Application Tester to ensure the quality, performance, and usability of mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for manual and automation testing of mobile apps to deliver high-quality user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements and create test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for mobile applications
  • Perform manual testing on Android and iOS devices
  • Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, UAT, and exploratory testing
  • Test mobile-specific features such as:
    • Push notifications
    • App installation/uninstallation
    • Device compatibility
    • Network conditions (2G/3G/4G/5G/Wi-Fi)
  • Validate UI/UX, gestures, screen resolutions, and orientations
  • Perform compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes
  • Log, track, and retest defects using tools like JIRA, Bugzilla, Azure DevOps
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and designers in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Perform API testing for mobile-backend communication
  • Validate app performance, stability, and battery usage

Required Skills

Mobile Testing Skills

  • Strong experience in Android and iOS application testing
  • Knowledge of mobile app life cycle
  • Understanding of mobile UX guidelines (Material Design, iOS HIG)
  • Experience with real devices and emulators/simulators

Tools & Technologies

  • Test management tools: JIRA, TestRail, ALM
  • API testing tools: Postman, Charles Proxy, Fiddler
  • Device cloud platforms: BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Firebase Test Lab

Automation (Preferred)

  • Experience with Appium (Android & iOS)
  • Knowledge of:
    • Selenium + Appium
    • TestNG / JUnit / Cucumber
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Basic knowledge of Java / Python / JavaScript

Performance & Security (Nice to Have)

  • Mobile performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner
  • Knowledge of mobile security testing (OWASP Mobile Top 10)
  • Experience testing offline/online sync scenarios

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and in teams
  • Attention to detail and quality mindset

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB / Mobile Testing Certification (optional)
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience in banking, e-commerce, healthcare, or fintech mobile appsRole & responsibilities

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities


  • Audio Transcription: Accurately transcribe dictated audio recordings from physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals into formal medical reports, clinical summaries, and administrative correspondence.

  • Electronic Health Record (EHR) Integration: Efficiently input, update, and maintain transcribed documents directly into the facility's EHR systems and digital database platforms.
  • Quality Assurance & Editing: Review and edit translated text for proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, and clarity, ensuring the final output matches the exact intent of the dictating clinician.
  • Compliance & Data Privacy: Strictly adhere to healthcare privacy laws (such as HIPAA) and institutional policies regarding patient data confidentiality and secure information handling.
  • Data Consistency Checking: Identify and flag clear inconsistencies, ambiguities, or missing information within clinical dictations, proactively consulting with the medical staff for clarification.
  • High-Speed Technical Typing: Maintain a high words-per-minute typing speed with a low error rate, utilizing specialized equipment like foot pedals, dictation software, and ergonomic text-expansion tools.
  • Standardized Formatting: Format all clinical documents including discharge summaries, operative reports, history and physical (H&P) examinations, and referral letters-according to institutional templates and medical layout guidelines.
  • Turnaround Time Management: Prioritize urgent dictations (such as stat reports or critical care summaries) to meet strict departmental turnaround times and ensure continuity of patient care.
  • Administrative Support: Assist with secondary administrative typing duties, archiving digital medical records, and maintaining accurate logs of transcribed files for department performance tracking.

jobDescription:

Job Responsibilities

  • Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
  • Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
  • Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.

Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
  • Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

  • Must have strong experience in Base SAS, Advance SAS/ SAS Macros.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Databricks Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities

Customer Architecture and Pre-sales

  • Lead executive and technical discovery workshops; translate business outcomes and non-functional requirements into Data + AI roadmaps and target architectures.
  • Architect end-to-end solutions covering ingestion, batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse storage, governance, data warehousing, analytics, ML/GenAI and operational applications.
  • Define phased migrations from legacy warehouses, Hadoop, cloud data platforms and ETL estates to Databricks.
  • Lead technical solutioning for proposals, demonstrations, RFP/RFI responses, estimates and proofs of value; clearly articulate business value and architectural trade-offs.
  • Collaborate with sales, delivery, cloud partners and Databricks account teams on joint pursuits and co-sell readiness.

Delivery Governance and Practice Building

  • Provide architecture governance from pursuit through production, including design, security, performance, cost and operational-readiness reviews.
  • Guide CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment strategy, testing, observability, release management and production support.
  • Define the practice roadmap, skills matrix, certification plan and hiring profile; mentor architects, data engineers and technical leads.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, discovery and estimation templates, demos, accelerators and technical playbooks.

Databricks Platform Expertise

Core Lakehouse, Data Engineering and Governance

  • Delta Lake and lakehouse design: ACID transactions, schema evolution, Change Data Feed, optimization and Medallion or domain data-product patterns.
  • Unity Catalog: catalogs/schemas, access controls, managed and external locations, lineage, discovery, audit, federation and Delta Sharing.
  • Lakeflow Connect, Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines and Lakeflow Jobs for ingestion, batch/streaming transformation, data quality, orchestration and observability.
  • Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL and Structured Streaming, including workload sizing, optimization and production troubleshooting.
  • Databricks SQL, serverless warehouses, query optimization, AI/BI dashboards and Genie for governed natural-language analytics.

AI, Applications and Platform Engineering

  • Lakebase architecture for PostgreSQL-compatible transactional workloads, application data and agent state, with appropriate integration to the lakehouse.
  • Mosaic AI and MLflow: model lifecycle, evaluation, serving, Vector Search, RAG, AI Gateway, monitoring and governed agentic patterns. Familiarity with Agent Bricks is valuable.
  • Databricks Apps and secure Data + AI application patterns, including the ability to separate operational, analytical and agentic workload requirements.
  • Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform, Git-based CI/CD, system tables, platform observability, serverless/compute policies and FinOps.
  • Azure architecture is preferred; AWS or Google Cloud experience is valuable. Familiarity with Kafka, ADF, dbt, Snowflake, Synapse or Power BI is advantageous.

Required Experience, Qualifications and Certifications

  • 10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, analytics or cloud data platforms, including at least 4 years of substantial Databricks experience.
  • Demonstrated success architecting and delivering enterprise-scale Databricks solutions in productionnot only isolated notebooks or pipelines.
  • Strong pre-sales capability across discovery, technical storytelling, estimates, proposals, demonstrations, proofs of value and senior customer presentations.
  • Strong SQL and Python/PySpark skills, with the ability to review implementations, troubleshoot designs and guide engineering teams.
  • Experience leading architecture governance and multidisciplinary teams; prior practice-building, hiring, mentoring or reusable-IP responsibility is strongly preferred.
  • Professional-level Databricks certification is strongly preferred at joining. An otherwise strong candidate must complete an agreed professional certification within six months.
  • Excellent communication, executive presence and structured problem-solving; able to explain technical and commercial trade-offs clearly.
  • Experience in consulting, a systems integrator or a Databricks partner is preferred, particularly in BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare/life sciences or retail.
  • Willingness to work from Palnis Hyderabad office and travel for customer or partner engagements when required.

title: Prior Authorization and Denial Management
tagsAndSkills: Neurology,Imaging and Diagnostics,Physical Therapy,Infusion Therapy,Prior Authorization,Eligibility Verification,Imaging,Eligibility Benefits
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities

  • Obtain prior authorizations across all client service lines and document them in the correct location in Athena.
  • Work denials end to end. Identify the denial reason, confirm root cause, correct and resubmit where documentation supports it, and appeal where it does not.
  • Call payers directly. Do not close a claim as non-recoverable without first contacting the payer, confirming the reason, and asking whether benefits or contract terms changed.
  • Pursue retro authorizations where a service was performed without an authorization on file.
  • Support letters of medical necessity by gathering the clinical documentation the payer is asking for and coordinating with the onsite team on drafting.
  • Identify and report patterns. If the same denial reason repeats, flag it to the client and adjust the authorization process to stop it at the front end.
  • Respond to client questions raised in Athena chat within the same business day.

Preferred candidate profile

  • athenaOne proficiency. Hands-on athenaOne experience with minimal ramp-up required. This is the client's firmest requirement. Candidates without real Athena time should not be shortlisted.
  • Three or more years obtaining commercial and government prior authorizations, including payer portal submissions and phone authorizations.
  • Three or more years in denial management or AR follow-up with demonstrated appeal experience on high-dollar claims.
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, and how documentation supports level of service.
  • Comfortable calling US payers and holding a line of questioning until the reason is confirmed. Persistence is being explicitly tested for.
  • Clear written English. All client communication happens in writing inside Athena.
  • Available for a full shift on Central Time.
  • HIPAA trained. Will work only under Staffingly's signed BAA and secured infrastructure.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior authorization experience with infusion therapy or specialty drugs, including buy and bill workflows.
  • Neurology, physical therapy, or diagnostic imaging authorization background.
  • Experience with medical necessity appeals for EEG, NCV, EMG or advanced imaging.
  • Clinical background (RN, PharmD, MBBS or equivalent) is a plus for medical necessity work.

DENIAL TYPES THIS ROLE WILL WORK

  • No authorization on file or authorization mismatch
  • Bundled or inclusive service denials
  • Medical necessity denials, most often on CT, EEG and NCV
  • Coding denials involving ICD-10 selection or modifiers
  • Level of service not supported by submitted documentation
  • Frequency limits and benefit maximum reached

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Authorizations obtained before date of service, with the approval documented in Athena in the agreed location.
  • No claim written off without a documented payer call and a stated reason.
  • Client questions in Athena chat answered same business day.
  • Weekly denial trend summary shared with the client, including repeat root causes and the fix applied.
  • Quality and productivity reviewed by the assigned Team Lead and by VP, RCM.

4. 5. Data Analysis & Reporting • Maintain accurate insurance records and policy registers. • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on: o Claims experience o Claims ratios o Vendor performance o Renewal status o Policy utilization o Insurance costs and savings initiatives • Provide analytical insights to support management decision-making.


6. Compliance & Risk Management • Ensure compliance with applicable insurance regulations and company policies. • Monitor policy obligations and contractual insurance requirements. • Support internal and external audits related to insurance programs. • Identify insurance-related risks and recommend mitigation measures. • Maintain confidentiality and security of insurance-related information.


7. Stakeholder Management • Partner with HR, Finance, Administration, Fleet, Legal, and Operations teams. • Provide guidance on insurance coverage, claims procedures, and policy matters. • Conduct awareness sessions for employees on group insurance benefits. • Handle escalations related to policy administration and claims services.

title: Walk-in || Anaesthetist
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities

A. Pre-Anaesthesia Assessment

  1. Conduct comprehensive pre-anaesthesia evaluation of patients scheduled for surgery / procedures.
  2. Review medical history, clinical condition, investigations, medications, allergies and previous anaesthesia history.
  3. Assess anaesthetic risk and determine the appropriate anaesthesia plan.
  4. Identify high-risk patients and communicate the risk to the treating surgeon / physician and patient as appropriate.
  5. Ensure required investigations and specialist opinions are available before planned procedures.
  6. Document pre-anaesthesia assessment and fitness / risk assessment appropriately.

B. Intra-Operative Anaesthesia Management

  1. Administer and monitor anaesthesia according to the patient's clinical condition and planned procedure.
  2. Ensure appropriate airway management and maintenance of adequate ventilation, circulation and oxygenation.
  3. Monitor vital parameters continuously throughout the procedure.
  4. Ensure appropriate use of anaesthesia drugs, equipment and monitoring devices.
  5. Maintain accurate anaesthesia records.
  6. Identify and manage intra-operative complications promptly.
  7. Coordinate with surgeons, nursing staff and OT personnel for safe conduct of procedures.
  8. Ensure compliance with surgical safety and patient identification protocols.

C. Post-Anaesthesia Care

  1. Assess patients following anaesthesia and determine their suitability for transfer from OT / recovery area.
  2. Monitor recovery from anaesthesia, including airway, respiration, circulation, consciousness and pain.
  3. Manage post-operative nausea, vomiting, pain and other anaesthesia-related complications.
  4. Ensure appropriate handover to the recovery room / ICU / ward team.
  5. Provide clear instructions regarding post-anaesthesia monitoring and further management.

D. Pain Management

  1. Provide peri-operative and post-operative pain management.
  2. Assess pain and response to treatment.
  3. Advise appropriate analgesic modalities based on patient condition and procedure.
  4. Participate in hospital pain-management initiatives and protocols.

E. Emergency & Resuscitation Services

  1. Provide anaesthesia support during medical and surgical emergencies.
  2. Respond promptly to emergency calls requiring airway management or resuscitation support.
  3. Assist in management of cardiac arrest, respiratory emergencies and other critical situations.
  4. Participate in Code Blue / resuscitation activities as per hospital protocol.
  5. Ensure readiness and appropriate use of airway-management and resuscitation equipment.

F. ICU / Critical Care Support

  1. Provide anaesthesia and airway-management support to critically ill patients wherever required.
  2. Assist in procedures requiring anaesthetic / sedation support.
  3. Coordinate with intensivists, physicians and surgeons regarding critical-care patients.
  4. Participate in multidisciplinary management of high-risk patients, as required.

G. Patient Safety & Quality

  1. Follow hospital policies, clinical protocols and NABH requirements applicable to anaesthesia services.
  2. Ensure correct patient identification and procedure verification before administration of anaesthesia.
  3. Follow medication safety and high-alert medication protocols.
  4. Ensure appropriate infection prevention and control practices.
  5. Report adverse events, near misses and anaesthesia-related incidents as per hospital policy.
  6. Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA and quality-improvement activities wherever assigned.
  7. Participate in morbidity and mortality reviews and clinical audits.

H. Documentation & Medical Records

  1. Maintain complete and accurate pre-anaesthesia, intra-operative and post-anaesthesia records.
  2. Ensure timely documentation of anaesthetic drugs, doses, monitoring parameters and significant events.
  3. Maintain appropriate informed consent documentation as per hospital policy.
  4. Ensure medical records are complete, legible and available for clinical review and audit.

I. OT & Equipment Management

  1. Ensure availability and functional readiness of anaesthesia machines, ventilators, monitors and airway-management equipment before procedures.
  2. Report equipment malfunction immediately to the concerned department.
  3. Ensure appropriate availability of emergency drugs and anaesthesia-related consumables.
  4. Coordinate with OT and biomedical engineering teams for preventive maintenance and calibration requirements.

J. Clinical Coordination

  1. Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, nursing staff and other clinical departments.
  2. Participate in pre-operative and post-operative clinical discussions for high-risk patients.
  3. Communicate relevant anaesthetic risks and peri-operative concerns to the treating team.
  4. Support appropriate escalation of clinically significant concerns.

3. Key Performance Areas / KRAs

KRAExpected PerformancePre-Anaesthesia AssessmentComplete and timely assessmentPatient SafetyCompliance with approved safety protocolsAnaesthesia DocumentationComplete and accurate recordsIntra-Operative MonitoringContinuous and appropriate monitoringEmergency ResponseTimely response and effective managementPost-Anaesthesia CareSafe recovery and appropriate handoverMedication SafetyCompliance with medication protocolsIncident ReportingTimely reporting and participation in corrective actionInfection ControlCompliance with applicable practicesClinical QualityParticipation in audits and quality initiatives

4. Educational Qualification

Essential:

  • MBBS from a recognised medical institution.
  • MD / DNB / Diploma in Anaesthesiology or equivalent recognised postgraduate qualification.
  • Valid registration with the applicable State Medical Council / National Medical Commission, as applicable.

5. Experience

  • Relevant experience as an Anaesthetist in a hospital setting.
  • Experience in general surgery, orthopaedics, obstetrics & gynaecology, ENT, urology and other surgical specialties shall be preferred based on hospital requirements.
  • Experience in emergency airway management, resuscitation and critical-care support shall be preferred.

6. Skills & Competencies

  • Strong clinical knowledge and decision-making ability.
  • Competence in airway management and resuscitation.
  • Ability to manage anaesthesia-related emergencies.
  • Good knowledge of peri-operative patient safety.
  • Good documentation skills.
  • Effective communication and coordination with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Commitment to ethical and patient-centred clinical practice.

7. Professional Conduct

  1. Maintain professional confidentiality regarding patient information.
  2. Follow applicable medical ethics and hospital policies.
  3. Maintain professional behaviour with patients, attendants and hospital staff.
  4. Participate in clinical meetings, training programmes and quality-improvement activities as required.
  5. Maintain required professional registration and credentials.

8. Overall Responsibility

The Consultant Anaesthetist shall be responsible for providing safe and effective peri-operative anaesthesia care, including pre-anaesthesia evaluation, intra-operative management, post-anaesthesia recovery, pain management and emergency airway/resuscitation support, while ensuring compliance with hospital clinical protocols, patient-safety requirements and applicable NABH standards.

jobDescription:
Title

Our successful Clinical Research Associates possess varied backgrounds in medical and other science-related healthcare fields.  Individuals who have succeeded in the CRA role include:

  • Nurses
  • Dieticians
  • Pharmacy Technicians
  • Pharmaceutical/Device Sales Representatives
  • Biotech Engineers
  • PhD/Pharm.D candidates
  • Health and Wellness Coordinators
  • Research Assistants. 

PACE® – MEDPACE CRA TRAINING PROGRAM

No research experience is needed as Medpace provides comprehensive initial and ongoing training, unmatched by other CROs.  Through our PACE® Training Program, you will join other  Professionals Achieving CRA Excellence:

  • PACE® provides the platform to effectively and confidently carry out your duties, enhance your current abilities and ultimately help you become a high-functioning independent Medpace CRA.
  • PACE® will prepare you by developing your CRA skills through interactive discussions and hands on job-related exercises and practicums.
  • To supplement your in-house and field-based training you may also participate in other clinical research departmental core rotations, learning other aspects of the drug/device development and approval process. 

UNEXPECTED REWARDS

 

This role takes you on a journey through travel and excitement which will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices.  The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

  • Dynamic working environment, with varying responsibilities day-to day
  • Expansive experience in multiple therapeutic areas
  • Work within a team of therapeutic and regulatory experts
  • Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements
  • Competitive pay and opportunity for significant travel bonus
Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Responsibilities

As a CRA Entry, you will specifically be responsible for the following:

  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating  protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Medical device and/or investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies,  and recommended actions to secure compliance. 
Qualifications
  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree;  Health or life science related field preferred;
  • Candidate with Clinical Research Coordinator experience is an advantage: 
  • Willing to travel approximately 60-80% nationally;
  • Familiarity with Microsoft® Office; and
  • Strong communication and presentation skills a plus.

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

 

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

 

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

 

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

 

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events 

 

Please note benefits may vary based on country. 

 

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

Connect directly with HR at isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in if you believe you are a strong fit.


PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE

jobDescription:
Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar | v1.0
C A R E A D H D
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited
Job Description
Clinic Operations Manager
Indiranagar, Bangalore
We are Care ADHD, and we are coming to India
We are one of the largest specialist ADHD providers in the United Kingdom. We were built inside the NHS system,
we are regulated by the Care Quality Commission, and we support tens of thousands of patients. We know what
world class neurodevelopmental care looks like because we deliver it every single day.
And now we are bringing it to India. Not a call centre. Not a back office. A real specialist clinic, in Indiranagar,
staffed by brilliant Indian psychiatrists and psychologists, delivering assessment and treatment to the same
clinical standard we hold ourselves to in the UK.
Here is why this matters. There are millions of adults in India with ADHD who have never had a name for the way
their mind works. Many have spent their whole lives being told they are lazy, careless or not trying hard enough.
Stigma around ADHD and autism stops people seeking help, and when they do seek help, specialist care is very
hard to find. We think that is wrong, and we intend to do something about it.
Our mission is to unlock potential. Every assessment we deliver is a person finally getting an accurate explanation
of themselves. Every treatment plan is someone getting their life back. And every open, honest conversation
about ADHD and autism chips away at a stigma that should never have existed in the first place.
The Indiranagar clinic is our first site in India. You would be running it. No pressure.
1. Role details

2. The role, in plain terms
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited |
Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar | v1.0
You own the running of the Indiranagar clinic. Everything that happens around the clinical encounter, from the
moment a patient first gets in touch to the point where they are settled on treatment and coming back for annual
review, is yours.
The job exists so that our clinicians can do clinical work and absolutely nothing else. If a psychiatrist is chasing an
invoice, fixing a rota or apologising for a late running clinic, you have a problem to solve.
This is a build role. You will open the clinic, set the operating rhythm and write down how everything works,
because what you build in Indiranagar is what we will replicate in the next city, and the one after that. We are
hiring for capability, not capacity. We want someone who can run one clinic brilliantly and then help us open the
next three.
What this role is
The operational owner of the clinic. The diary, the team, the patient experience, the building, the numbers. If
it is not clinical, it is yours.
A leadership job. You will line manage the patient services team from day one and set the tone for the whole
clinic.
A founding job. You will be one of the first people through the door, and the way you work will become the
way we work.
A partnership job. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our Clinical Director, our Compliance department
and our Finance department, and with UK colleagues who genuinely want you to succeed.
A mission job. You will spend your days making it easier for people with ADHD to get help, in a country where
that is still far too hard.
What this role is not
It is not a clinical role. Diagnosis, prescribing and therapy decisions belong to the clinicians, always. You make
their work possible. You never influence it.
It is not a caretaker role. There is no established machine to keep ticking over. If you want a clinic that already
runs itself, this will frustrate you.
It is not a back office or shared services role. This is a patient facing clinic. You will see and hear the impact of
your work in the waiting room every day.
It is not a solo compliance or finance role. Compliance owns the regulatory framework and Finance owns the
numbers. You are their partner on the ground, not a one person substitute for either.
It is not a nine to five with everything defined. Some weeks will be messy. We will be honest about that now
rather than surprise you later.
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited |
Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar |

treatment. Adults only at this stage

psychological therapy delivered alongside or in place of medication

4. What you will do
Six areas. You own all of them. We have written these as accountabilities rather than tasks, because we care
about the outcome and we trust you on the method.
4.1 Clinic operations and patient flow
Run the day to day operation of the clinic so that every clinic session starts on time, runs to time and is fully
utilised.
Own the clinic diary and capacity plan. Manage clinician utilisation, session templates, appointment mix and
slot allocation against the monthly volume plan.
Manage did not attend and cancellation rates actively, including reminder protocols, waiting list management
and short notice backfill.
Ensure the clinic environment, equipment, consumables and facilities are safe, clean, functional and fit for a
clinical setting at all times.
Own vendor and supplier relationships at clinic level, including facilities, housekeeping, security, pathology
partners and consumables.
Maintain accurate operational records and produce a weekly operating report against agreed metrics.
4.2 Patient experience and pathway progression
Own the patient experience end to end, from first enquiry through assessment, titration and into
maintenance and annual review.
Ensure every patient understands what happens next in their pathway, what it will cost and when they will
next be seen.
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited |

Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar | v1.0
Manage enquiry response times and booking conversion, working with the marketing and growth function on
lead handling and follow up. Track and improve pathway progression rates, in particular the proportion of assessed patients who
commence and remain on appropriate treatment.
Own the clinic complaints and feedback process, working closely with Customer Success under Kat Frize,
resolving concerns locally where appropriate and escalating in line with group policy.
Ensure patient communications are clear, accurate, culturally appropriate and consistent with the Care ADHD
brand and clinical position.
4.3 People and team leadership
Lead, line manage and develop the patient services and front of house team, including recruitment,
induction, rostering and performance management. Build a rota that matches staffing to clinic demand across the operating week, managing leave and absence
without service disruption.
Hold regular one to one meetings and appraisals, and maintain individual development plans for every direct
report.
Ensure all staff complete mandatory training and induction, and maintain accurate training records.
Work with the People and Talent function on employment compliance under Karnataka labour law, including
working hours, statutory registers and payroll inputs.
Model the standard of professionalism and patient centredness that we expect of everyone in the clinic.
4.4 Quality, safety and regulatory compliance
Work in partnership with the group compliance department to maintain the clinic in a continuous state of
registration compliance under the Karnataka Private Medical Establishments Act, including all licences,
certificates and statutory displays.
Lead clinic level preparation for NABH accreditation with the group compliance department, owning the
evidence base, policy adoption and audit readiness at site level.
Own clinic level health and safety, fire safety, infection prevention and control, and biomedical waste
management.
Ensure all incidents, risks, near misses and safeguarding concerns are reported through the group reporting
system without delay, and that actions are closed out.
Deliver the clinic audit calendar, including clinical record audits, and present findings and improvement
actions to the Clinical Director India.
Maintain the clinic risk register and escalate in line with the group risk appetite framework.
4.5 Commercial and financial performance
Hold accountability for clinic level financial performance against budget, including revenue, direct costs and
contribution, working in partnership with the Finance department.
In partnership with the Finance department, ensure every episode of care is correctly priced, invoiced and
collected, with no revenue leakage between the clinical record and the ledger.
Manage clinic petty cash, purchase approvals and expenditure within delegated limits, in partnership with the
Finance department and in line with group financial controls.
Produce accurate monthly forecasts of volume, revenue and headcount cost with the Finance department,
and explain variance.
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited |

Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar | v1.0
Identify and deliver efficiency improvements that reduce unit cost per assessment without reducing clinical
quality.
4.6 Growth, scaling and replication
Document the Bangalore operating model to a standard that allows it to be replicated in a second city
without rework.
Contribute to site selection, fit out planning and mobilisation for the second clinic.
Build relationships with local referrers, employers, universities and partner organisations that generate
sustainable patient demand. Support the group India workstream with operational input, data and local market intelligence.
Deputise for the Clinical Director India on operational and administrative matters as required.
Care Neurodiversity India Private Limited |

Job Description | Clinic Manager, Indiranagar | v1.0
5. You should apply if
You have run a clinic, hospital unit, diagnostic centre or something comparably operational, and you loved
the days when everything ran on time.
You have opened something new, or you have always wanted to and never had the chance.
You believe patients deserve hospitality grade service and hospital grade safety at the same time, and you
refuse to trade one for the other.
You are comfortable being the most organised person in the building.
You care about mental health and neurodiversity, and the idea of breaking stigma in India genuinely excites
you.
And you probably should not apply if
You need a detailed playbook before you can act. We are writing the playbook. That is partly your job.
You see patient experience as a front desk function rather than the whole point.
You want to make clinical decisions. That door is closed and it stays closed.
You are looking for a role you can do quietly. This one comes with visibility, to the UK executive team and to

Company Name: Swiftly Meds Private Limited
Industry: Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare and Medicine Export

Work Mode: Full-time, On-site
Department: Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management

Monthly Performance Incentive: 10,000–12,000
Total Monthly Earning Potential: 40,000–42,000
Annual Earning Potential: Approximately 4.80–5.04 lakh
Immediate Joiners Preferred

About Swiftly Meds Private Limited

Swiftly Meds Private Limited is a pharmaceutical wholesale, distribution and export company based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.

The company supplies a broad range of pharmaceutical and healthcare products, including:

  • Pharmaceutical tablets
  • Pharmaceutical capsules
  • Pharmaceutical injections
  • Anti-cancer medicines
  • Inhalers and respiratory medicines
  • General healthcare and pharmaceutical products
  • Bulk pharmaceutical orders

Swiftly Meds serves domestic and international pharmaceutical buyers and focuses on reliable sourcing, product quality, transparent communication, proper documentation, secure packaging and timely delivery.

Our mission is to build long-term relationships with customers and partners by providing dependable pharmaceutical sourcing and responsive customer support.

Job Summary

We are hiring a confident, disciplined and result-oriented International Sales & Customer Relationship Executive.

The selected candidate will be responsible for handling domestic and international customer enquiries, understanding product requirements, preparing quotations, following up with potential buyers, converting enquiries into confirmed orders and maintaining long-term customer relationships.

The role involves a combination of:

  • B2B pharmaceutical sales
  • International sales
  • Export sales coordination
  • Lead generation
  • Tele-sales
  • Customer relationship management
  • Order follow-up
  • Payment coordination
  • Repeat-order generation

This is not only a calling position. The candidate will manage the complete sales journey from the first customer enquiry to quotation, negotiation, order confirmation, payment follow-up, dispatch coordination and post-sale relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Handling and Qualification

  • Handle incoming enquiries from the company website, email, telephone, WhatsApp and approved B2B marketplaces.
  • Contact domestic and international pharmaceutical buyers.
  • Understand the customer’s required product, brand, strength, dosage form, quantity, destination country and delivery expectations.
  • Verify whether the enquiry is genuine and commercially relevant.
  • Collect necessary customer and business information before processing an order.
  • Prioritise high-value and urgent sales opportunities.
  • Maintain professional response times for all incoming enquiries.

2. B2B Pharmaceutical Sales

  • Explain the company’s products, services, sourcing capabilities and order process to potential customers.
  • Share approved product information, prices, availability and commercial terms.
  • Prepare and send quotations and proforma invoices after obtaining internal approval.
  • Follow up consistently with interested customers.
  • Negotiate prices and commercial terms within company-approved limits.
  • Convert enquiries and quotations into confirmed orders.
  • Achieve assigned monthly sales, revenue, collection and repeat-order targets.
  • Identify opportunities for bulk orders and long-term supply arrangements.

3. International and Export Sales

  • Communicate professionally with customers from different countries.
  • Handle international enquiries through email, WhatsApp and telephone calls.
  • Understand customer requirements related to quantity, shipping destination, packaging and documentation.
  • Coordinate internally for export quotations and estimated shipping charges.
  • Support customers with approved export documentation requirements.
  • Coordinate with the operations, logistics and documentation teams for international orders.
  • Maintain accurate communication regarding order status, payment, packaging and dispatch.
  • Follow company policies and applicable pharmaceutical and export regulations.

4. Customer Relationship Management

  • Build strong and professional relationships with domestic and international customers.
  • Act as the customer’s main point of contact during the sales and order process.
  • Provide regular updates regarding quotations, payments, product availability and dispatch.
  • Follow up with existing customers for repeat orders.
  • Understand customer feedback, concerns and future requirements.
  • Support the resolution of customer complaints by coordinating with the relevant internal team.
  • Maintain customer satisfaction without making unapproved medical, regulatory or delivery commitments.
  • Develop long-term business relationships instead of focusing only on one-time sales.

5. Quotation and Order Coordination

  • Prepare accurate quotations based on approved pricing.
  • Confirm product, quantity, price, packaging and shipping information before sending quotations.
  • Coordinate with the procurement or inventory team regarding product availability.
  • Follow up on pending quotations and purchase decisions.
  • Obtain complete order confirmation from the customer.
  • Coordinate for proforma invoice preparation.
  • Ensure that customer details and order information are accurately recorded.
  • Track the order until payment, packaging, dispatch and delivery communication are completed.

6. Payment and Collection Follow-up

  • Communicate approved payment terms to customers.
  • Follow up professionally for advance payments and outstanding amounts.
  • Coordinate with the accounts team to verify received payments.
  • Do not confirm an order or dispatch without the required internal payment approval.
  • Maintain records of pending payments and expected payment dates.
  • Escalate delayed or suspicious payments to management.
  • Support timely collection of sales revenue.

7. CRM and Sales Reporting

  • Record every lead, call, message, quotation, follow-up and order status in the company CRM or tracking system.
  • Maintain accurate and updated customer records.
  • Schedule future follow-ups and avoid missing customer commitments.
  • Submit daily sales and follow-up reports.
  • Prepare weekly pipeline and performance updates.
  • Report monthly sales, revenue, collections, repeat orders and pending opportunities.
  • Share customer objections, product demand and competitor information with management.
  • Maintain complete transparency regarding customer discussions and deal status.

8. Market Development

  • Research potential pharmaceutical importers, wholesalers, distributors, pharmacies and healthcare businesses.
  • Identify new domestic and international markets.
  • Generate leads through online research, directories, references and approved platforms.

Job Title:

Job Summary:
An E/M (Evaluation and Management) Surgery Medical Coder is responsible for reviewing physician documentation and assigning accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifier codes for surgical E/M services. The coder ensures compliance with AMA, CMS, and payer-specific guidelines while supporting accurate reimbursement and reducing claim denials.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze surgical patient records, office visits, consultations, hospital visits, and follow-up encounters.

    • General Surgery
    • Orthopedic Surgery
    • Neurosurgery
    • ENT Surgery
    • Urology
    • Cardiothoracic Surgery
    • Plastic Surgery
  • Ensure documentation supports the selected E/M level.
  • Identify and report documentation deficiencies to providers when clarification is required.
  • Follow current AMA CPT and CMS E/M coding guidelines.
  • Ensure compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, HIPAA, and commercial payer requirements.
  • Review denied claims and assist in coding corrections when necessary.
  • Meet productivity and quality standards established by the organization.
  • Stay updated on annual coding guideline changes.

Required Qualifications

  • Certification preferred:

  • Knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifiers.
  • Understanding of surgical documentation and medical terminology.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and coding accuracy.
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems.

title: Critical Care Doctor
jobDescription:
Job Description (JD)

Position: Attending Consultant / Associate Consultant Critical Care

Department: Critical Care

Reporting To: Senior Consultant / Director Critical Care

Experience

35 years of post-MD/DNB experience in Critical Care within a reputed multi-specialty or tertiary care hospital.


Qualification

  • MD/DNB in Anaesthesia, Internal Medicine, Respiratory Medicine, Emergency Medicine, or equivalent.
  • Fellowship/DM/DNB in Critical Care Medicine (preferred).
  • Valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC)/State Medical Council.

Job Summary

The Attending/Associate Consultant – Critical Care is responsible for delivering high-quality, evidence-based critical care services to critically ill patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). The incumbent will manage complex medical emergencies, coordinate multidisciplinary care, perform critical care procedures, and ensure patient safety while maintaining the highest standards of clinical excellence.


Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Assess, diagnose, and manage critically ill patients admitted to the ICU.
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans based on evidence-based clinical protocols.
  • Perform comprehensive daily patient rounds and document clinical findings accurately.
  • Monitor and manage patients requiring advanced organ support, including mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, renal replacement therapy, and invasive monitoring.
  • Perform bedside critical care procedures such as:
    • Central venous catheter insertion
    • Arterial line placement
    • Endotracheal intubation
    • Percutaneous tracheostomy (where credentialed)
    • Chest tube insertion
    • Ultrasound-guided procedures
  • Respond promptly to medical emergencies, code blue events, and rapid response team activations.
  • Ensure timely referrals and collaborate with specialists for multidisciplinary patient management.

Patient Care & Quality

  • Maintain adherence to ICU clinical protocols, infection prevention guidelines, and patient safety standards.
  • Communicate effectively with patients' families regarding diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment plans.
  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation in the Electronic Medical Records (EMR).
  • Participate in mortality and morbidity meetings, quality audits, and clinical governance initiatives.
  • Promote antibiotic stewardship and rational use of critical care resources.

Academic & Research

  • Participate in CMEs, journal clubs, departmental academic sessions, and case presentations.
  • Contribute to clinical research, publications, and quality improvement projects.
  • Mentor junior doctors, residents, fellows, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with NABH/NABL and hospital quality standards.
  • Participate in ICU duty rosters and provide emergency coverage as required.
  • Support implementation of departmental policies, SOPs, and clinical pathways.
  • Coordinate with nursing, respiratory therapy, laboratory, radiology, and other support departments for seamless patient care.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong clinical expertise in Critical Care Medicine.
  • Excellent knowledge of ventilator management and advanced life support.
  • Expertise in managing sepsis, shock, ARDS, trauma, and multi-organ failure.
  • Proficiency in invasive bedside procedures.
  • Sound clinical decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure environments.
  • Team-oriented with a patient-centric approach.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and clinical excellence.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in managing Medical, Surgical, Cardiac, Neuro, and Trauma ICU patients.
  • Exposure to ECMO, CRRT, bronchoscopy, point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS), and advanced hemodynamic monitoring will be an added advantage.
  • Experience working in NABH-accredited hospitals.

title: General Anaesthesia Doctor
jobDescription:
Job Description (JD) Associate Consultant General Anaesthesia

Job Title: Associate Consultant – General Anaesthesia
Department: Anaesthesia
Reporting To: Senior Consultant / Director – Anaesthesia
Experience: 5+ years of post MD/DNB experience in General Anaesthesia within a multispecialty or tertiary care hospital


Qualification:

  • MD/DNB in Anaesthesiology from a recognized institution
  • Valid State Medical Council/NMC registration
  • Fellowship in Critical Care, Regional Anaesthesia, Pain Management, or Cardiac/Neuro Anaesthesia will be an added advantage

Job Summary

The Associate Consultant – General Anaesthesia is responsible for providing comprehensive perioperative anaesthesia care across multiple surgical specialties. The role includes pre-operative evaluation, administration of anaesthesia, intraoperative patient management, post-operative pain management, emergency response, and ICU support while ensuring patient safety and adherence to clinical protocols.


Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive pre-anaesthetic evaluations and assess patients for surgical fitness.
  • Formulate individualized anaesthesia plans based on patient condition and surgical requirements.
  • Administer general, regional, and monitored anaesthesia safely for elective and emergency procedures.
  • Monitor patients throughout surgery and manage any intraoperative complications.
  • Provide post-operative monitoring, pain management, and recovery care.
  • Participate in management of critically ill patients requiring airway management and ventilatory support.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations including trauma, code blue, obstetric emergencies, and difficult airway management.
  • Support ICU and emergency department for critical patient care whenever required.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of anaesthesia records and clinical notes.

Patient Care & Safety

  • Ensure compliance with NABH, infection control, and patient safety standards.
  • Follow WHO Surgical Safety Checklist and departmental protocols.
  • Promote safe medication practices and anaesthesia equipment safety checks.
  • Ensure informed consent and effective patient counselling regarding anaesthesia procedures.

Academic & Quality Responsibilities

  • Participate in departmental CMEs, academic meetings, mortality & morbidity reviews, and case discussions.
  • Guide and mentor junior residents and postgraduate trainees.
  • Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and protocol development.
  • Stay updated with advances in anaesthesia techniques and evidence-based practices.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Coordinate effectively with surgeons, nursing staff, OT personnel, and ICU teams.
  • Assist in OT scheduling and efficient utilization of operation theatres.
  • Ensure proper maintenance and readiness of anaesthesia machines, monitors, and emergency equipment.
  • Maintain compliance with hospital policies, accreditation standards, and documentation requirements.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong clinical expertise in general and regional anaesthesia.
  • Proficiency in airway management, difficult airway algorithms, and resuscitation.
  • Experience in perioperative critical care and emergency anaesthesia.
  • Sound knowledge of anaesthesia equipment and monitoring systems.
  • Excellent clinical judgment and decision-making abilities.
  • Effective communication and multidisciplinary collaboration skills.
  • Strong documentation and medical record management.
  • Commitment to ethical medical practice and patient-centered care.

Preferred Experience

  • Minimum 5+ years of post MD/DNB experience in General Anaesthesia at a tertiary care or multispecialty hospital.
  • Experience across specialties including General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Urology, ENT, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Gastro Surgery, Oncology, Neurosciences, and Laparoscopic Surgery.
  • Exposure to ICU, trauma care, and emergency anaesthesia will be preferred.
